- [ ] Contrast holds in light, dark and `prefers-contrast: more` (tests pass)
- [ ] Keyboard and screen reader checked for interactive changes
- [ ] Story and docs page updated (if a component changed)
- [ ] Visual baselines updated in Docker, and the diffs are intended (if UI changed)
- [ ] Breaking or deprecating? Follows `docs/DEPRECATION.md`
